whatsNew.summary: Ask follow-up questions after a meeting ends, then review an answer as a follow-up in Work. Fact check public claims with supporting sources when requested. Requires server 6.71.12. Private test candidate.

sections.title: Continue a saved meeting
items: Ask uses the original recording and its saved cutoff. Each capture keeps its own question history.
Short answers and inline citation taps from the previous candidate are included.

sections.title: Review a follow-up
items: Edit an answer into a follow-up and save it in Work Review. The original answer and source excerpts stay attached.
Cancel saves nothing. A retry does not create another copy or reopen a reviewed item.

sections.title: Useful requested assistance
items: What to ask suggests at most one grounded question. Solo prompts run only when requested.
Sources and context shows availability and your confirmed domain. A checked time is not presented as a sync time.

sections.title: Stable transcription
items: This update does not enable experimental transcription or autonomous live cues.
